item.description: Good morning, Sydney! It’s Friday, May 1st, 2026, and a beautiful autumn day awaits us with sunshine and a top of 23 degrees – perfect for that end-of-week feeling. Welcome back to your Daily Drive! Did you know today marks the start of National Volunteer Week here in Australia? A wonderful reminder of the power of giving back. Let's make today count!
